MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 12

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 7
   C. 9
   D. 8

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 41
   C. 40
   D. 13

4. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

5. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 8

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

7. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 3
   D. 11

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

9. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

12. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 24

13. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 19

14. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 81

16. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
